ui.chakraRootQuestion1: How supported and grounded do you generally feel in your life?
ui.chakraRootQuestion2: Do responsibilities or uncertainty often affect your sense of stability?
ui.chakraRootQuestion3: What helps you feel settled, supported, and present over time?
ui.chakraSacralQuestion1: How freely do your emotions move through your daily life?
ui.chakraSacralQuestion2: Do you feel connected to creativity, enjoyment, and healthy expression?
ui.chakraSacralQuestion3: What helps you reconnect with enjoyment, creativity, or emotional ease?
ui.chakraSolarQuestion1: How confident do you generally feel when making decisions?
ui.chakraSolarQuestion2: Do hesitation, self-doubt, pressure, or overextension frequently affect you?
ui.chakraSolarQuestion3: What kind of support helps you move from reflection into purposeful action?
ui.chakraHeartQuestion1: How connected do you feel to yourself and the people around you?
ui.chakraHeartQuestion2: Is self-kindness easy for you, or do you often place others first?
ui.chakraHeartQuestion3: What helps you feel connected, understood, and able to receive care?
ui.chakraThroatQuestion1: How freely do you communicate your needs, feelings, and boundaries?
ui.chakraThroatQuestion2: Do you generally feel heard and understood?
ui.chakraThroatQuestion3: What would help you express what matters to you with more ease?
ui.chakraThirdEyeQuestion1: How clear and focused does your mind generally feel?
ui.chakraThirdEyeQuestion2: Do you often experience overthinking, distraction, or uncertainty?
ui.chakraThirdEyeQuestion3: What kind of support helps you find perspective and return to one clear focus?
ui.chakraCrownQuestion1: How connected do you feel to meaning, purpose, or inner stillness?
ui.chakraCrownQuestion2: Would silence, spaciousness, or gentle contemplation support your ongoing journey?
ui.chakraCrownQuestion3: What gives your life a sense of meaning, perspective, or quiet renewal?

ui.consentSubtitle: Review the complete confirmation before opening the camera.
ui.consentScript: I, {name}, confirm that I have reviewed my preferences and the approved plan for this guided wellness session, whose stated goal is {goal}. I understand that the session may include {services}, as discussed and approved with my guide. {touch} {medication} I understand that these are non-medical wellness services and do not replace diagnosis, treatment, or advice from a qualified healthcare professional. I have had the opportunity to ask questions. I may decline any optional service, request a change, pause, withdraw my consent, or stop the session at any time. I voluntarily agree to participate and consent to this audio-video confirmation being recorded as part of my session record. This declaration is made on {date} at {location}.
ui.consentServicesNone: guided meditation only, with no additional physical or care services
ui.consentMedicationAcknowledgment: I have disclosed that I am taking prescribed medication. I will not stop, start, or change my medication because of this session without consulting my prescribing clinician.
ui.consentMedicationNone: I am not taking prescribed medication that affects my participation in this session.
ui.consentTouchYes: I agree to discuss and receive only the touch or assistance stages listed in my approved plan, and I may decline any stage before it begins.
ui.consentTouchNo: I do not consent to touch or physical assistance. Touch-dependent care stages will not be included.
ui.consentScrollHint: Review the complete confirmation above. During recording, it will scroll gently for you.
ui.consentReviewHint: Read the complete confirmation before continuing.
